value.rationale: This examines the smallest asymmetric alphabet step of a natural metric graph Cech family, demonstrating a sharp new degree-four homology obstruction between widths three and four. A substantial finite integral homotopy calculation plus an all-width simplicial retraction establishes survival of a primitive fourth-homology class across infinitely many graph sizes, not just a small table or routine reparametrization. It answers a motivated mixed-dimensional topology question at the first threshold.
